fakes: db_private_alloc_release / db_private_free_release / db_private_realloc_release over malloc/free with counters (the release-build macros of memory_alloc.h; memory_alloc.c is not linked), db_alignment / db_align_to (memory_alloc.c's bodies, which fixed_alloc.c's record size calls), er_set/er_errid/er_clear (records the code), prm_Def (ORACLE_STYLE_EMPTY_STRING and ORACLE_COMPAT_NUMBER_BEHAVIOR false, the booted defaults pr_clear_value and the DB_VALUE code read). Real: query_aggregate.cpp, object_primitive.c, db_macro.c, memory_hash.c (mht_get_hash_number), fixed_alloc.c + heaplayers/customheaps.cpp (the slab's LockedHeap<FreelistHeap<ZoneHeap>>). mix()/unmix() in test.cpp copy the sketch's lowbias32 re-mix and its inverse to predict the register and rank (K1).
note: S5/S6 are 'current' numbers the review cites (allocations per group on each path; the block layout for one INTEGER key + one aggregate, and for Q1's two keys + eight aggregates) -- they change when the layout or the cache's key copy changes, and then the suite is updated with the finding. K1 checks the branchless rank the review proposes (clz ((m << 10) | 0x200) + 1) against the head's loop for ranks 1..23 and 2M random hashes. K2 is the equivalence behind 'feed the sketch at group creation only'. No [defect] case: no defect was found in these functions.
